Infiltrate the enemy-held war zone and run a recon-in-force!
No need to go deep, but hit any enemies that appear without hesitation!

An interception mission against an enemy assault force!
Hold back the enemy advance until our allies arrive!

Wipe out the enemy units deployed around the war zone!
Scatter them and break the enemy's momentum!

This operation's goal is to stop enemy units coming in from the surrounding areas!
Hold off their reinforcements and isolate the enemy garrison in this war zone!

This mission is to defend a Data Probe set up by our allies!
Defending the probe, which gathers and analyzes intel on the mysterious enemy,
is a vital mission that could change the course of the war!

The Data Probe is destroyed if it takes too much damage.
Protect the probe until data collection is complete!

This mission is to recover a Data Probe that drifted into another dimension!
Head to a battlefield outside "this world", defend the Data Probe and recover it!

A note.
This mission isn't set on a battlefield modeled on the Gundam world,
but on a map made from virtual data of "the real world".
Enjoy a battle with a different flavor!

Welcome to GGF! Welcome to Gundam Great Front!
The venue is packed! It's full of the excitement of so many visitors!
Check the crowding info for each attraction at the entrance!

This is the Gundam Great Front special live studio!
Today's recommended attraction is the "Psycommu Experience Simulator", using brainwave detection!
Just by thinking, you can freely move the bits
in a virtual space!
Be sure to try this amazing attraction!

GGF News!
At the popular "Psycommu Experience Simulator", where you control bits with your brainwaves,
a player has set an overwhelming kill count, far beyond any record so far!
Maybe this person is a real Newtype!
If you haven't tried it yet, why not take on this record?

Welcome to Gundam Great Front!
Today's recommended attraction is "Gundam Fight Battle Match"!
Easy two-button controls! Pilot a realistically recreated giant mobile fighter and beat your opponent with punches and kicks!
Will God win!? Or Master!?
This super-exciting battle game is looking for new challengers! Join in!

GGF News!
Gundam Great Front has lots of fun places besides the attractions!
Take the express elevator to the "Bridge Observatory" overlooking Odaiba!
If you're hungry, try the great original menu at the Gundam Restaurant!
And the Gundam Shop has GGF-original Gundam goods, like the "Strike Gundam Phase Shift Battery Checker" that shows the charge by its armor color!
Be sure to drop by!

GGF News!
The Gunpla display corner shows many original-design Gunpla built by famous modelers!
The builders are also taking part in "Battle Live-G",
so if you find a Gunpla design you like, cheer for it in "Battle Live-G" too!

GGF News!
This evening's outdoor hologram live show is the "1/1 Scale Dendrobium"!
Experience the overwhelming scale of the Dendrobium soaring through the Odaiba sky!
The next show is planned to be the "1/1 Scale Rafflesia"!
Look forward to it!

The Gunpla battle live event "Battle Live-G"!
Skilled Gunpla modelers and Gundam gamers gather in one place!
The Gunpla each player built is fully turned into data, workmanship and all!
On a diorama battlefield, they fight heated battles against the strongest enemy, "Gundam"!
The battles are always broadcast live on the big monitors in the venue! Enjoy!

Battle Live-G!
Because it's far more popular than expected, we're now recruiting more general players!
If you want to take part, apply to the event office!
New players, and customized machines never seen before, will create new battle drama!
The excitement is building!

Battle Live-G!
In the Gunpla Battle Simulator, a machine's strength isn't decided by looks alone!
With great model-building skill, even a Zaku or a GM can easily outperform higher-end machines!
And its strength changes a lot with the player's own skill and the weapon combination!
Watch the live plays and find the truly strong, skilled players!

Gunpla Battle TV!
Today again we bring you extreme battle scenes by the selected players!
What machines will the selected players take into battle!
And can they break through the overwhelmingly difficult missions!
Look forward to the heated action! Check it out!

Gunpla Battle TV!
Gunpla Battle TV is now holding a vote: "Viewers' Choice! Best Gunpla Battle Scenes"!
Tell us your favorite player and your favorite battle scene!
The best battle ranking will be decided from the results!
Look forward to it!

Gunpla Battle TV!
Today again we bring you carefully selected extreme battle scenes by the selected players!
Next time we'll take a break from the regular content
for a special: "Behind Gunpla Battle! Selected Player Interviews!"
Look forward to it!

Gunpla Battle TV!
News just in: some of the most popular machines the selected players have used
are being considered for plastic model kits!
If it's true, you'll be able to build those dream machines yourself!
We'll let you know as soon as there's more!

Gunpla Battle TV!
Here's a fun bit of Gundam-related news!
During an experiment at a thermonuclear fusion facility, an unknown particle was found
that lines up in a 3D lattice at a certain density!
...Could this be... Minov...
If it's true, the Gundam world might become real one day! It's a dream come true!
Welcome!
This is the "Players' Shop", just for "Battle Live-G" players!

Here we offer "Gunpla" with a full set of machine parts,
and "Avatars" that are you in the VR Hangar, in exchange for GP earned in missions.

However, under the battle event's rules, the weapon runners
are removed from the "Gunpla". We ask for your understanding.

The Gunpla and avatars you can get
are added one after another as you progress.
We'll send you a mail when new items arrive,
so check your Breakers Mobile.

You can also trade the runners you won in battle and the parts you made
for GP.
